added: Category: swimwear lifestyle. Place: an empty indoor training pool just before opening, pale aqua water, an unused diving starting block and soft window light. A small swimming balance board rests entirely on the dry pool deck.

Activity and moment: she is barefoot on the dry balance board, practicing a slow sideways balance stretch. Her weight stays over the board; her torso leans gently to her left while her head remains turned toward the camera. Both arms extend forward and outward at shoulder height, each naturally connected to its own shoulder, both open relaxed hands clearly visible, no objects held. The stretch opens the lateral cut-out on the far side of the suit more clearly to the camera; this is deliberate fitted construction, no clothing accident, displaced strap, wind, water splash or transparent fabric.

Outfit: an original fully lined matte coral swimming set whose supportive curved two-cup bodice joins a high-waisted opaque brief through two broad braided textile bridges at the front waist; the bridges form oval side windows, with a racer-style back yoke and small flat resin clasps. Fitted secure swimsuit coverage of chest and pelvis, bare shoulders, side waist and legs. No armor or creature patterns. One tiny golden paired-dot hair clip is her sole species accessory.

Composition: full body, a gentle frontal three-quarter angle at chest-height camera, her face and both hands readable, feet and dry board fully visible. Quiet spring morning, diffuse light and gentle water caustics on the walls. Her eyelids are softly lowered and her lips relaxed as she concentrates on a slow breath.

added: Place: the open passenger deck of a small river ferry, with rippling water, a low wooden bench and sunlit riverbanks beyond. She is taking an unhurried ride after buying a two-flavour shaved-ice cup, amused by the two halves melting at different speeds.

Activity and pose: she sits diagonally on the bench with her knees together and both feet on the dry deck. Her left arm comes forward from her left shoulder; her left hand holds the single dessert cup at waist level. Her right arm bends naturally from her right shoulder; her right hand holds one short wooden spoon just above the cup. Each hand has one job. She turns her face toward the camera and laughs.

Outfit: a fitted sea-glass blue stretch-cotton playsuit with a plunging folded petal neckline, bare shoulders, a single continuous spiral seam wrapping the waist into an asymmetric rounded hem over fitted opaque shorts, and a tiny carved wooden clasp at one hip. The spiral cut leaves one crescent of waist bare; the bodice, chest and pelvis remain securely covered, opaque and lined. Flat cork sandals. This is relaxed contemporary clothing, with no creature palette or armor. A small paired-bead pendant is the sole species motif.

Composition: a knee-up three-quarter view from seated eye height, showing her face, both arms and the cup clearly. Warm midday light, soft river reflections, a distant shoreline; no other passengers visible.
